## Gaps vs JD

- Role is customer-facing (solutions architecture, technical account leadership). Resume is all engineering titles, no formal customer-facing or pre-sales role. Closest evidence: Payly Pay SDK adopted by merchant web and native teams (S5), Fabrikam as own product.
- No experience owning a named customer portfolio, technical account plans or executive (CTO/CIO/CISO) relationships.
- AI production depth: PDF-Chat (S3), Grammar Checker AI suggestions (S1). No ChatGPT Enterprise or Codex deployment work for customers.
- Strong on the architecture foundations they list: APIs, distributed systems, auth/identity (S5), JS/TS prototyping.

## JD (role-relevant parts)

Team: Technical Success. Location: Delhi, Mumbai or Bangalore, hybrid 3 days in office.

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn Initech's models into real-world impact, design secure and scalable solutions, and move them from exploration into sustained production adoption.

**Role:** Senior technical owner for a named customer portfolio, the "CTO of your book of business". Owns the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the Initech API, Codex and agentic solutions. Account Director owns commercial strategy; AI Architect owns technical strategy, customer journey and path to production value.

**In this role:**
- Primary technical advisor and relationship owner for existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
- Own technical account plan, milestones, adoption priorities, expansion opportunities.
- Lead discovery with executives and technical teams; qualify and prioritize use cases.
- Design Applied AI Architectures: models, apps, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, deployment.
- Run evaluations, demos, workshops, prototypes, proofs of value.
- Maintain a use-case portfolio with decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures.
- Build champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams.
- Coordinate Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, specialists and partners; stay accountable for outcomes.
- Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, impact.
- Feed customer insights back to Product, Engineering and Research.

**Might thrive if you:**
- Significant experience in customer-facing technical roles (SA, SE, TAM, AI deployment, technical CS).
- Guided enterprises from evaluation to production adoption and measurable impact.
- Credible with senior leaders and hands-on engineers.
- Strong software and cloud architecture: APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, privacy.
- Understand frontier LLMs, agentic apps, evals, retrieval, enterprise AI workflows.
- Can prototype in Python or JavaScript and explain tradeoffs.
- Judgment on when to go deep vs bring in specialists.
- Technical account plans, portfolio prioritization.
- Industry expertise or digital-native fluency.
- Turn ambiguity into a technical narrative or action plan.
